title: Reciprocal Sums of Higher Figurate Numbers

problemStatement.formal: Define triangular, pentagonal, and hexagonal figurate numbers; prove triangular reciprocal partial fractions, basic figurate identities, and square-reciprocal summability.
problemStatement.plain: Formalizes higher figurate-number reciprocal infrastructure, including triangular partial fractions, examples for square/pentagonal/hexagonal numbers, the hexagonal-triangular identity, and convergence of square reciprocals.
whyMatters: Connects triangular reciprocal telescoping with broader figurate-number families.
Provides reusable convergence and identity infrastructure for related reciprocal-series questions.

hexagonal_eq_triangular proves every hexagonal number is triangular.
square_reciprocals_summable proves summability of square reciprocals.
